title: Velori design exploration starter and static Review and Cart continuation
origin: The unchanged starter comes from approved handbook 2.0.0. The editable answer key adds the Review action and Cart frame on October 7, 2026; the October 6 Claude Design trial retains its original scope.
changes: Starter remains unchanged: four source pages and no completed Store exercise page.
Continuation retains the four source pages and a separate editable Review and Cart page with Velori component instances, text styles and variable bindings.
Review uses Add to cart. Cart shows Graphite, Simple, Amber, Carry bag and quantity one, with Edit cart item and Continue configuring.
No prototype connections or choice-state wiring. These are static editable frames.
No new native Claude Design generation trial is claimed. The React and standalone answers implement the cart behavior independently.
fontDelivery: No font binaries bundled. The trial loaded Arimo and Lora through Google Fonts.

artifacts.recipientImport: Original October 6 starter imported into Claude Design. Starter bytes remain unchanged.
Saved through Figma Save local copy after native canvas inspection. Fresh recipient import and separate-account access checks were not repeated for this standard export.
